| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Hue from** `hueMin` | 330 | 0 to 360 deg | The start of the hue range. If it is above Hue to, the range wraps through 0 degrees. |
| **Hue to** `hueMax` | 30 | 0 to 360 deg | The end of the hue range. |
| **Saturation from** `satMin` | 40 | 0 to 100 % | The smallest saturation that counts. |
| **Saturation to** `satMax` | 100 | 0 to 100 % | The largest saturation that counts. |
| **Value from** `valMin` | 30 | 0 to 100 % | The smallest value, the brightness of the strongest channel, that counts. |
| **Value to** `valMax` | 100 | 0 to 100 % | The largest value that counts. |
| **Invert** `invert` | off | On or off | Make the pixels outside the ranges white instead. |
